title: LaunchGood community-project evidence leads
policy: Illustrative organiser narratives. Not independent verification of needs, project efficacy, ongoing status, tax or zakat eligibility, personal duty or religious merit. Inclusion is not an endorsement.
sample_note: Purposive non-representative selection. Do not rank community needs by fundraising volume.

cases.title: Food, healthcare and water for displaced families
cases.region_and_type: Emergency and relief · Sudan and Chad
cases.organizer_and_source: Sudanese American Physicians Association (SAPA) · LaunchGood · Campaign statement reviewed 13 November 2026
cases.organizer_stated_intervention: Community kitchens, maternal and newborn healthcare, and water, sanitation and hygiene activities presented together.
cases.research_interpretation: A single relief appeal may combine multiple functions, so treating it as a generic “charity job” conceals the different skills and institutional dependencies.
cases.suggested_capacities: Clinical staff · public health · cooks and food logistics · WASH engineers · coordination
cases.independent_verification_needed: Independent service coverage, displacement data, needs of mothers and infants, supply reliability, and programme outcomes.

cases.title: An integrated hospital water system
cases.region_and_type: Infrastructure · El Geneina, West Darfur, Sudan
cases.organizer_and_source: SAPA · LaunchGood · Campaign statement reviewed 13 November 2026
cases.organizer_stated_intervention: Fundraising to improve water provision near a hospital, including pumping, storage, treatment and distribution—not drilling alone.
cases.research_interpretation: The function is dependable safe water for care and hygiene; a well is a means whose operation and maintenance matter.
cases.suggested_capacities: Water engineers · hydrogeologists · hospital operations · water-quality monitoring
cases.independent_verification_needed: Independent water-quality results, prior capacity, operating costs, long-term maintenance arrangements and asserted beneficiary coverage.

cases.title: Tailoring skills and sewing equipment
cases.organizer_and_source: Kijana Kwanza · LaunchGood · Campaign statement reviewed 13 November 2026
cases.organizer_stated_intervention: Tailoring instruction followed by provision of sewing equipment for women seeking to earn income.
cases.research_interpretation: Training, tools, market access and household support form an interdependent pathway, rather than a single one-off transfer.
cases.suggested_capacities: Vocational trainers · small-business mentors · market researchers · safeguarding staff
cases.independent_verification_needed: Graduates' long-term income, demand for products, machine maintenance, household circumstances and comparison with other livelihood options.

cases.title: Food parcels for orphaned children living with relatives
cases.organizer_and_source: Kijana Kwanza · LaunchGood · Campaign statement reviewed 13 November 2026
cases.organizer_stated_intervention: Household food support for children living with grandparents, siblings or other family caregivers.
cases.research_interpretation: The unit of need may be the existing household, not an orphanage or other new institution. Care, nutrition and schooling overlap.
cases.suggested_capacities: Community care coordinators · food procurement · household social work · child safeguarding
cases.independent_verification_needed: Household eligibility, access to food and education, existing family support and continuity of provision.

cases.title: A mosque as a centre for several community functions
cases.organizer_and_source: Southgate Mosque · LaunchGood · Campaign statement reviewed 13 November 2026
cases.organizer_stated_intervention: A fundraising appeal connected to premises costs and ongoing programmes including a food bank, youth activities, learning and plans for a school.
cases.research_interpretation: The religious building, teaching function, social services and financial sustainability are analytically separate—yet institutionally connected.
cases.suggested_capacities: Trustees · financial governance · teachers · food-bank coordinators · facilities managers
cases.independent_verification_needed: Programme usage, affordability and access, alternative facilities, finances and community consultation.

cases.title: Islamic education across stages of learning
cases.region_and_type: Education · United States / Egypt educational connections
cases.organizer_and_source: Organiser named on the linked LaunchGood campaign · LaunchGood · Campaign statement reviewed 13 November 2026
cases.organizer_stated_intervention: An education fundraising campaign describing support for learning from early schooling through advanced Islamic studies.
cases.research_interpretation: Provision is not just the number of books or lessons. Teacher formation, learner pathways and institutions able to sustain transmission matter.
cases.suggested_capacities: Scholars and teachers · curriculum researchers · assessment specialists · education administrators
cases.independent_verification_needed: Precise beneficiaries, curricular quality, credential structure, teaching capacity, existing alternatives, and achieved learning.

cases.title: Mental-health research and professional formation
cases.region_and_type: Care and health · Muslim professional and community networks
cases.organizer_and_source: Organiser named on the linked LaunchGood campaign · LaunchGood · Campaign statement reviewed 13 November 2026
cases.organizer_stated_intervention: Support for culturally grounded research, practitioner mentorship, education and efforts to improve accessible mental-health care.
cases.research_interpretation: An appeal can concern knowledge-production and professional capacity as well as direct treatment.
cases.suggested_capacities: Clinicians · researchers · supervisors · professional educators · service evaluators
cases.independent_verification_needed: Actual unmet demand, clinical safety, training standards, access barriers, outcomes and provision by existing services.

cases.title: Solar-powered water provision for displaced families
cases.region_and_type: Emergency and relief · Bweyale / Kiryandongo, Uganda
cases.organizer_and_source: Droplets of Mercy USA · LaunchGood · Campaign statement reviewed 13 November 2026
cases.organizer_stated_intervention: A relief campaign reporting the completion of a solar-powered well serving a refugee-camp cluster and plans to extend provision.
cases.research_interpretation: Emergency intervention and long-term institutional maintenance should be assessed separately; self-reported completion needs follow-up.
cases.suggested_capacities: Humanitarian coordination · water engineering · camp management · community maintenance committees
cases.independent_verification_needed: Actual usage, water safety, maintenance, independent beneficiary counts and coordination with camp authorities.

cases.title: Support for children who have lost parental care
cases.region_and_type: Care and health · Central Java, Indonesia
cases.organizer_and_source: Rumah Wakaf · LaunchGood · Campaign statement reviewed 13 November 2026
cases.organizer_stated_intervention: Family support and assistance with schooling costs and access for orphaned children.
cases.research_interpretation: Free public tuition does not necessarily mean schooling is accessible when travel, materials, food or family obligations remain barriers.
cases.suggested_capacities: Community assessors · educational access coordinators · caseworkers · waqf administrators
cases.independent_verification_needed: School attendance, eligible household needs, alternative assistance and sustained outcomes.
